description: The exact outbound HTTP request the data plane makes when delivering the D3 CRITICAL decision to Meridian's webhook endpoint. The body is egress/webhook-body.json verbatim (524 bytes); X-Kseal-Signature is HMAC-SHA256(secret, body) hex-encoded, exactly as server/data-plane/webhook/dispatcher.go computes it.

signature.computed_over: the raw response body bytes, before any transfer encoding

notes: The endpoint URL must be a public address: the dispatcher uses the SSRF-hardened safehttp client, so a tenant cannot point a webhook at a loopback/private/link-local host to pivot inside the network. Retries reuse the same body and signature; 408/429/5xx are retried with capped exponential backoff, other 4xx are permanent.
